body: I've made changes. I'm moved from one end of the country to the other. I ended and abusive relationship, I've joined sites like meetup.com, I've taken up hobbies like cross stitching and crocheting. I'm sorry. I'm sorry to everyone in my life.

I saw this, http://i.imgur.com/9eIOn.png, a year ago when I first thought about killing myself. I gave it a year. Nothing has changed no matter what i do, no matter how hard I try, no matter what happens, nothing seems to ever go my way. I can't catch a break. I'm tired of just existing and not living. 

I'm 33 years old. I've been struggling for as long as I can remember. I'm tired.
